captions.text: PackOverflow here. What do you need to know?
Hi, I have a meeting with the bank in ten minutes about the nightly payroll export. Who actually knows how the retries work?

Marc knows this. He corrected it to retry the upload three times, not five, because the bank closes the SFTP window at six in the evening and a late export gets rejected anyway. He last thought about it twelve days ago. This is going dark though, only Marc understands it right now. Want me to ping him?

Marc corrected that you should retry the upload three times, not five, because the bank closes the SFTP window at six in the evening and a late export gets rejected anyway. He also decided to start the export at five in the afternoon so a failed upload still has an hour before the window closes.
I'd send that ping to Marc now. Good luck with your meeting!
